* Convenience class for reading and writing streams of bytes.
 *
 * @hide

methods.name: public static int readSingleByte(@NonNull InputStream in) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Implements {@link InputStream#read(int)} in terms of {@link InputStream#read(byte[], int, int)}.
     * {@link InputStream} assumes that you implement {@link InputStream#read(int)} and provides default
     * implementations of the others, but often the opposite is more efficient.
     *
     * @param in {@link InputStream} to read byte from
     * @return singlge byte read from {@code in}
     * @throws IOException in case of I/O error
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static void writeSingleByte(@NonNull OutputStream out, int b) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Implements {@link OutputStream#write(int)} in terms of {@link OutputStream#write(byte[], int, int)}.
     * {@link OutputStream} assumes that you implement {@link OutputStream#write(int)} and provides default
     * implementations of the others, but often the opposite is more efficient.
     *
     * @param out {@link OutputStream} to write byte to
     * @param b byte to write to stream {@code out}
     * @throws IOException in case of I/O error
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static void readFully(@NonNull InputStream in, @NonNull byte[] dst) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Fills byte buffer {@code dst} with bytes from {@link InputStream} {@code in}, throwing
     * {@link EOFException} if insufficient bytes are available.
     *
     * @param in {@link InputStream} to read data from
     * @param dst byte buffer to write data to
     * @throws IOException in case of I/O error
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static void readFully(InputStream in, byte[] dst, int offset, int byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads exactly 'byteCount' bytes from 'in' (into 'dst' at offset 'offset'), and throws
     * EOFException if insufficient bytes are available.
     *
     * Used to implement {@link java.io.DataInputStream#readFully(byte[], int, int)}.
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static byte[] readFully(@NonNull InputStream in) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns a {@code byte[]} containing the remainder of {@code in} stream and
     * closes it. Also see {@link #readFullyNoClose(InputStream)}.
     *
     * @param in {@link InputStream} to read data from
     * @return remaining bytes in {@code in} stream.
     * @throws IOException thrown by {@link InputStream#read(byte[])}.
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static byte[] readFullyNoClose(@NonNull InputStream in) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns a {@code byte[]} containing the remainder of {@code in} stream, without
     * closing it.
     *
     * @param in {@link InputStream} to read data from
     * @return remaining bytes in {@code in} stream.
     * @throws IOException thrown by {@link InputStream#read(byte[])}.
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static String readFully(@NonNull Reader reader) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads the remainder of {@code reader} as a string, closing it when done.
     *
     * @param reader {@link Reader} instance.
     * @return remainder of {@code reader} as {@link String}.
     * @throws IOException thrown by {@link Reader#read(java.nio.CharBuffer)}.
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static void skipAll(InputStream in) throws IOException
public static long skipByReading(@NonNull InputStream in, long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Skip at most {@code byteCount} bytes from {@code in} by calling read * repeatedly until either the stream is exhausted or we read fewer bytes than * we ask for. * *

This method reuses the skip buffer but is careful to never use it at * the same time that another stream is using it. Otherwise streams that use * the caller's buffer for consistency checks like CRC could be clobbered by * other threads. A thread-local buffer is also insufficient because some * streams may call other streams in their skip() method, also clobbering the * buffer. * * @param in {@link InputStream} to skip data from * @param byteCount number of bytes to skip from {@code in} * @return number of bytes skipped from {@code in} * @throws IOException in case of I/O error * * @hide

methods.name: public static int copy(@NonNull InputStream in, @NonNull OutputStream out) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Copies all of the bytes from {@code in} to {@code out}. Neither stream is
     * closed.
     *
     * @param in {@link InputStream} to copy data from
     * @param out {@link InputStream} to write copied data to
     * @return the total number of bytes transferred.
     * @throws IOException reading from {@link InputStream} or writing to {@link OutputStream}.
     *
     * @hide

methods.name: public static String readAsciiLine(InputStream in) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the ASCII characters up to but not including the next "\r\n", or
     * "\n".
     *
     * @throws java.io.EOFException if the stream is exhausted before the next newline
     *     character.
     *
     * @hide
